It is wonderful that you are focusing on building more positive relationships right now. Recognizing that desire is a great first step toward creating meaningful and fulfilling connections in your life. To foster healthier relationships, it can help to start by reflecting on what "positive" means to you—whether that involves mutual respect, open communication, or shared interests. 

Setting clear boundaries and practicing active listening are powerful ways to nurture trust and understanding with others. Remember that building strong connections takes time and patience. Being kind to yourself and showing up authentically will naturally draw people who appreciate and support you for who you are.
